Index: <runs>\opencode-openai-1\repo\README.md
===================================================================
--- <runs>\opencode-openai-1\repo\README.md
+++ <runs>\opencode-openai-1\repo\README.md
@@ -1,6 +1,12 @@
-An HTTP server that routes each request by the method and target in its request line.
+An HTTP server that parses request lines, headers, and Content-Length bodies before routing.
 
+`/echo` accepts any method and returns plain text containing the method and path (for example, `POST /echo`). Existing GET routes `/` and `/users/:userId/posts/:postId` are also supported. Malformed or truncated requests return 400 Bad Request. Transfer-Encoding is not supported.
+
+Requests are limited to an 8192-byte request line (configurable with `MAX_REQUEST_LINE_BYTES`), 64 KiB of headers, and a 1 MiB body. Each connection handles one request and then closes.
+
+Test: `npm test`
+
 Run: `node server.js`
 
 Minimum Node.js version: 22
